observation.command: echo '=== login page ==='; curl -s -L -H 'Host: keycloak.workspace.localhost' --max-time 20 "http://127.0.0.1:80/realms/swcode/protocol/openid-connect/auth?client_id=urbo&redirect_uri=http://app.workspace.localhost/&response_type=code&scope=openid" | grep -oE '<title>[^<]*|login-keycloak' | head -3; echo '=== postgres roles/db ==='; docker exec urbo-workspace-urbo-backend-postgres-1 psql -U postgres -tAc "SELECT datname FROM pg_database;" 2>&1; docker exec urbo-workspace-urbo-backend-postgres-1 psql -U postgres -d urbo -tAc "SELECT count(*) AS tables FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public';" 2>&1; docker exec urbo-workspace-urbo-backend-postgres-1 psql -U postgres -d urbo -tAc "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 40;" 2>&1
